description: This file defines a 'ProductCard' component using LightningJS framework. It includes UI markup, properties, state, computed properties, and methods for interaction such as adding products to cart, adjusting quantity, and displaying product details.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a product card with image, description, and controls.

methods.name: $increment
methods.description: Increases the product quantity by one, up to the maximum stock available.

methods.name: $decrement
methods.description: Decreases the product quantity by one, ensuring it doesn't go below 1.

methods.name: $addToCart
methods.description: Adds the current product and quantity to the shopping cart and temporarily changes opacity for visual feedback.
